tool.name: Portkey AI Gateway
tool.description: Open-source AI gateway that routes to 250+ LLMs with fallbacks, caching and 50+ guardrails; managed SaaS and private-cloud options.
strengths: MCP gateway with auth and observability
tool.pricing: Developer free (10k recorded logs/month); Production $49/month (100k logs, $9 per extra 100k up to 3M); Enterprise custom with VPC/private cloud.
tool.statusNote: Palo Alto Networks completed its acquisition of Portkey on 2026-05-29, and Portkey is now the AI gateway for Prisma AIRS. Gateway 2.0, which merges Portkey's production gateway into the open-source codebase, has been a pre-release on the 2.0.0 branch since 2026-03-24.
tool.practitionerNote: The OSS gateway is easy to self-host, while logs, audit logs and private-cloud deployment come with the paid tiers. Now that Palo Alto Networks owns Portkey, check the roadmap and licensing of the open-source repo before standardising on it.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: Self-host the OSS gateway, or use Enterprise VPC hosting / private cloud with data isolation.

deployment.detail: OSS gateway (self-hosted), managed SaaS, and Enterprise hybrid / private-cloud deployments.

auditLogging.detail: Audit logs of administrative activity are an Enterprise plan feature.

soc2.detail: Portkey states it is SOC 2 certified; the Enterprise plan lists SOC2 Type 2. Applies to the hosted service, not self-hosted OSS.

iso27001.detail: Portkey states it is ISO 27001 certified (hosted service).

iso42001.detail: No ISO 42001 claim found in Portkey docs or pricing pages.

euAiAct.detail: Routing and guardrail infrastructure, not an AI system placed on the market; obligations rest with the deployer and model providers.

licenseRisk.detail: MIT (main branch LICENSE) — permissive, OSI-approved. Paid features are in the hosted plans, not the repo.
